Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items

so at this time.

Approval of the minutes of the meetings held on February 10, 2022.

Permit Request (s):

Item #1:  Megan Eremita DBA CSM Sport & Entertainment to host a HBO Takes the Court
  Event at 400 W. Beach Ave., Rogers Park, on Friday, March 4, 2022, from 7:00 a.m.
  – 12:00 p.m. (Activity No.00340590)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Item #2:  Noelle Lai DBA UCLA Blood & Platelet Center to host a Blood Drive Event at One
  Manchester Blvd., City Hall, Community Room # A, on Wednesday, June 15, 2022,
  from 8:00 a.m. – 1:00 p.m. (Activity No.00340555)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Item #3:  Laverne Smith DBA Consortium for Belizean Development, Inc. to host a Belize
  Caye Fest 2022 Event between South La Brea Ave, and South Market St., Public
  Property, on Sunday, July 03, 2022, from 2:00 p.m. – 10:00 p.m. (Activity
  No.00340557)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Item #4:  Laverne Smith DBA Little Belize Restaurant to host an Inglewood Caribbean Reggae
  Festival Event, In front of 217 E. Nutwood St., Little Belize Restaurant, Public
  Property, on Sunday, July 17, 2022, from 2:00 p.m. – 10:00 p.m. (Activity
  No.00340556)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.
